meta.name: common-asl
meta.what: English word -> ASL gloss labels that commonly express it, where the label is not the same English word.
meta.provenance: Authored by the SignIR team from widely used ASL sign/English correspondences in ASLLRP gloss conventions. Entries were chosen while inspecting false alarms on development data (asllrp, asllrp_paper test files); no held-out document was consulted. Not yet reviewed by a qualified ASL linguist or Deaf signer.
meta.licence: Same as the repository (GPL-3.0); contains no corpus text.
